description: This file defines a Dart class `ChessGameController` that manages the state of a chess game using the `chess.dart` library. It includes functionalities such as move validation, move history, undo/redo, AI move generation with adjustable difficulty, and game outcome detection. The class extends `ChangeNotifier` for reactive UI updates in Flutter.

classes.name: MoveRecord
classes.description: A simple data class that records a move made in the game, including SAN notation, source and target squares, and whether it was made by AI.

classes.name: ChessGameController
classes.description: A controller class managing the state and logic of a chess game, including move history, AI interactions, game status, and persistence of difficulty settings.

methods.name: _toBool
methods.description: Converts various types to a boolean, accommodating both boolean values and callable boolean getters.

methods.name: _pieceToMap
methods.description: Converts a piece object from chess.dart into a map with 'type' and 'color' keys for UI representation.

methods.name: _moveToMap
methods.description: Converts a move object to a map with detailed move info such as 'from', 'to', 'san', etc.

methods.name: setDifficulty
methods.description: Sets the AI difficulty level and saves it to shared preferences.

methods.name: _loadDifficulty
methods.description: Loads saved difficulty setting from shared preferences during initialization.

methods.name: newGame
methods.description: Resets the game state to start a new game.

methods.name: makePlayerMove
methods.description: Attempts to make a move for the player given source and target squares; triggers AI move if applicable.

methods.name: undo
methods.description: Undoes the last move, updating move history accordingly.

methods.name: redo
methods.description: Reapplies a move that was previously undone.

methods.name: aiMoveNow
methods.description: Triggers the AI to make a move immediately if it's its turn.

methods.name: _aiMoveAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous method that computes and applies the AI's move after a brief delay.

methods.name: _chooseBestMove
methods.description: Selects the best move for AI according to a minimax algorithm with alpha-beta pruning, based on difficulty.

methods.name: _negamax
methods.description: Recursive negamax search implementation for move evaluation.

methods.name: _evaluateBoard
methods.description: Simple heuristic evaluating material and mobility for the current board state.
